soundness_flags.label: def:order-jackknife and Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: T_{i,ell} is never defined from O_i: the construction does not specify the ell-subset or its order statistics, so J_{i,m} and the benchmark estimator are not defined measurable procedures.

soundness_flags.one_line: The stated one-sided observed-arm smoothness defines a discontinuity, but no cross-cutoff continuity condition for each potential average-quantile curve licenses calling that discontinuity a causal LAQTE.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The empirical-quantile extension requires a growing, asymptotically balanced within-distribution sample size and then gives the same uniform limiting processes and valid bootstrap bands as the population-quantile procedures.

For bounded unit sample sizes, two laws on latent distributions can induce the same observed grouped-sample law while having different barycenter quantiles; the proof uses Bernoulli latent distributions and matching finite moments.
The paper derives optimal sup-norm rates for discretely observed functional-data mean functions, with sparse, intermediate observation-error, and dense regimes.
The paper develops unified Gaussian approximation and simultaneous confidence bands for sparse-to-dense functional-data mean-function estimation.

The paper derives leading distribution and quantile bias from shrinking noisy draws and gives analytic and jackknife corrections that recenter limit distributions and yield large-sample confidence intervals.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the half-sample statistic using a fixed named split of the m raw draws (or an independent auxiliary split), then state whether the two halves are averaged; revise the jackknife formula accordingly.

Replace r and t in the cusp construction by explicit sequences r_m and t_m, state positivity and C^gamma-radius inequalities for every m, and make the complete-tuple equality and target separation calculations part of the membership proposition.

Either add standard potential-average-quantile continuity across the cutoff for both treatment states or rename the target throughout as an observed LAQTE discontinuity rather than a causal treatment effect.

recommended_next_step: Revise the three well-posedness/coherence defects, then advance the unchanged all-regime modulus frontier to Stage 0.
